item.title: Ahbar Günlük Bülten — Sayı #33 (2026-11-20)
item.description:
Ahbar Sayı #33 (2026-11-20):
1. [Bilgisayar Bilimi & Yazılım] PostgreSQL 19 — Hacker News (Bilgisayar Bilimi & Yazılım) Bilgisayar Bilimi & Yazılım alanında Hacker News tarafından yayımlanan teknik araştırma ve analiz raporu: PostgreSQL 19 Released Most years PostgreSQL ships a new release in September, but this year's release came two months later thanks mainly to the flurry of issues that the PostgreSQL team needed to address as part of the ongoing AI-reported vulnerability apocalypse. This release was definitely worth the wait. My favorite new feature is this one: For applications that send reads to standbys, PostgreSQL 19 adds "read-your-writes" consistency with the new WAIT FOR LSN command.
2. [Yapay Zekâ & Makine Öğrenmesi] Posterior Matching Distillation — Hugging Face Daily Papers (Yapay Zekâ & Makine Öğrenmesi) Yapay Zekâ & Makine Öğrenmesi alanında Hugging Face Daily Papers tarafından yayımlanan hakemli/ön-baskı araştırma makalesi: Diffusion distillation accelerates image and video generation by compressing a pretrained teacher's iterative sampling process into a few network evaluations. Distribution-based methods achieve this by matching the student's output distribution to the teacher's. This matching is often driven by reverse-KL objectives, whose mode-seeking bias favors dominant teacher modes at the expense of diversity across samples.
3. [Matematik & Biçimsel Bilimler] Quasipolynomial pyjamas. The ``pyjama stripe" $E(\varepsilon)$ is the set of all complex numbers whose real part lies within $\varepsilon$ of the nearest integer. — arXiv Mathematics (NT, CO, AG, LO, AT, GR) (Matematik & Biçimsel Bilimler) Matematik & Biçimsel Bilimler alanında arXiv Mathematics (NT, CO, AG, LO, AT, GR) tarafından yayımlanan hakemli/ön-baskı araştırma makalesi: The ``pyjama stripe" $E(\varepsilon)$ is the set of all complex numbers whose real part lies within $\varepsilon$ of the nearest integer. The Pyjama Problem asks whether, for each $\varepsilon > 0$, there exists some union of finitely many rotations of $E(\varepsilon)$ about the origin that covers the plane. This was answered in the affirmative by Manners.
4. [Fizik, Kuantum & Uzay] Fractional Charge at Dislocations from Band-Inversion Cancellation. Band inversions with opposite Chern numbers cancel in the Hall response and yield counterpropagating boundary modes that can gap out. — arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) (Fizik, Kuantum & Uzay) Fizik, Kuantum & Uzay alanında arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) tarafından yayımlanan hakemli/ön-baskı araştırma makalesi: Band inversions with opposite Chern numbers cancel in the Hall response and yield counterpropagating boundary modes that can gap out. However, a bulk probe of the topology that survives such a cancellation is lacking. We here show that dislocations in inversion-symmetric two-band crystals with cancelling band inversions bind a half-integer charge, which reveals the quantized bulk polarization of the bond-centered obstructed atomic limit realized by such crystals.
5. [Sistem, Donanım & Tüketici Teknolojisi] OpenSSL: Buffer overflow in EVP_EncodeBlock() (CVE-2026-121481, CVSS 9.8) — Hacker News (Sistem, Donanım & Tüketici Teknolojisi) Sistem, Donanım & Tüketici Teknolojisi alanında Hacker News tarafından yayımlanan teknik araştırma ve analiz raporu: Published via Hacker News in Systems, Hardware & Applied Tech. Primary discussion and technical specification available at the linked source.
6. [Biyoteknoloji, Tıp & Malzeme Bilimi] ARC-Impute: robust reference-guided spatial gene imputation through regularised cell-to-spot mapping — bioRxiv Bioinformatics Preprints (Biyoteknoloji, Tıp & Malzeme Bilimi) Biyoteknoloji, Tıp & Malzeme Bilimi alanında bioRxiv Bioinformatics Preprints tarafından yayımlanan hakemli/ön-baskı araştırma makalesi: Motivation: Reference-guided spatial imputation uses single-cell RNA sequencing references to predict genes that are unmeasured in spatial transcriptomics data. Limited shared-gene overlap can leave the mapping of reference cells to spatial locations ambiguous: different assignments may reconstruct observed genes similarly yet yield different imputed expression and cell-type estimates. This gives rise to local assignment ambiguity, source-target mismatch and reference-transfer instability.
7. [Kriptografi, Web3 & Dağıtık Protokoller] Possible futures of the Ethereum protocol, part 6: The Splurge — Vitalik Buterin's Blog (Kriptografi, Web3 & Dağıtık Protokoller) Kriptografi, Web3 & Dağıtık Protokoller alanında Vitalik Buterin's Blog tarafından yayımlanan teknik araştırma ve analiz raporu: Published via Vitalik Buterin's Blog in Cryptography, Web3 & Protocols. Primary discussion and technical specification available at the linked source.
8. [Ekonomi, Finans & Makro Analiz] Stability Bands for Feature Attribution: The Core, the Nucleolus and the Bargaining Set of Explained-Variance Games — arXiv Economics (econ.EM, econ.GN, econ.TH) (Ekonomi, Finans & Makro Analiz) Ekonomi, Finans & Makro Analiz alanında arXiv Economics (econ.EM, econ.GN, econ.TH) tarafından yayımlanan hakemli/ön-baskı araştırma makalesi: Shapley-value attributions are the default way of explaining machine-learning predictions in economics, but they report a single number per feature and say nothing about whether a coalition of features that jointly accounts for more than it receives could contest that allocation. We study feature attribution through the core, the nucleolus and the bargaining set of an explained-variance game, in which the worth of a set of features is the variance of the model's predictions that those features generate. For every feature we report a stability band (its range of shares over the core, or over the least core when the core is empty), with the nucleolus as distinguished point and a certificate that the allocation admits no justified objection.
9. [Uluslararası İlişkiler, Jeopolitik & Strateji] The Paradox of Dollar Dominance. The dominance of the U.S. dollar is a crucial source of American global power. — Foreign Affairs (Uluslararası İlişkiler, Jeopolitik & Strateji) Uluslararası İlişkiler, Jeopolitik & Strateji alanında Foreign Affairs tarafından yayımlanan teknik araştırma ve analiz raporu: The dominance of the U.S. dollar is a crucial source of American global power. 10. [Bilim Felsefesi, Karar Kuramı & Bilişsel Bilimler] Safe Subgame Resolving in Multiplayer Games. Poker and other games with hidden information are too large to solve in one pass. — arXiv Game Theory, Complex Systems & Soc-Phys (cs.GT, nlin.AO, physics.soc-ph) (Bilim Felsefesi, Karar Kuramı & Bilişsel Bilimler) Bilim Felsefesi, Karar Kuramı & Bilişsel Bilimler alanında arXiv Game Theory, Complex Systems & Soc-Phys (cs.GT, nlin.AO, physics.soc-ph) tarafından yayımlanan hakemli/ön-baskı araştırma makalesi: Poker and other games with hidden information are too large to solve in one pass. Strong systems compute a complete blueprint strategy offline and refine it in real time inside the reached subgame. In 2p0s games, a safety theorem guarantees that subgame resolving never increases how much an adversary can gain by exploiting the resolved strategy relative to the blueprint strategy.
